question: Does packed four-bit evaluation of the existing projected S3 row maps reduce complete index-calculus relation-oracle work against the merged optimized kernel, with every per-query table construction charged?

claims.text: Exact matching decisions, witness indices/order, common and projected diagnostics on all cases; no scalar-tail/fallback truncation.
On BOTH uniform controls oracle Ir drops>=5% and whole cold-query Ir drops>=1%; all six A/A discrepancies<=1%, no other cold cell regresses>1%.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: One executable contains byte-identical merged solver snapshot and candidate, using SAME actual current field/context modules and SAME qualified support snapshots. Only projected row evaluation differs; all per-query table construction charged.

factors.name: instances
factors.how: Six disclosed prior d12 cases. Identical compact single-query payload on every arm; eight hashes include the two additional positive pilot targets. No old all-workload parser result is used as a new arm.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Rotate three arms by field/kind/repetition; five rounds.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: Single-threaded native solver; one CPU allocation and2GiB process address-space ceiling for the proposed local exception.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Recorded AMD EPYC9V74 virtual x86 host; CPU0, no PMU; simulated instructions only, no native timing claim.

factors.name: cache_and_layout
factors.how: Fresh native/profile processes per query; no cached factor-base or symbolic setup is free. Eager/lazy setup crossed across all algorithms; all initialization charged.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: Outer600second total guard, no retries; raw process output and flushed JSONL prefixes retained.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Compiled deterministic summary is hashed before affected data, with no adaptive sample selection or population inference.

primary.definition: Client-request partition from before solver call through returned report. Includes base admission, all projection/precompute/search, roots/lifts and internal replay; given context/input construction is separate setup, not silently free.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed6cases x3arms x5repetitions=90 primary rows; separate12-call pilot and2-process final counter calibration.
Stop on any invalid Found/Refuted result, preserving all rows.
Combined final calibration/pilot/freeze/primary600seconds at CPU0/2GiB, zero retries and paid resources; preserve any failed prefix.

decision_rule.text: Both uniform cells require lookup/baseline complete oracle Ir<=0.95 and whole cold-query Ir<=0.99. All exact outputs and phase sums must agree; all6 A/A discrepancies<=1%; every other cold cell lookup/baseline<=1.01. Otherwise preserve partial/inconclusive result without threshold change.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-cell five-repeat min/median/max; exact paired median ratios, six A/A discrepancies and explicit no-regression checks
decision_rule.interval: Exact repeat ranges only; exposed anchors, no population CI
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Ratio of identical-boundary complete cold-process or complete relation-oracle simulated instructions

inadmissible: No timing, scaling, population, full-DLP or challenge-recovery claim.
UNKNOWN is not UNSAT; no row deletion, adaptive seeds or comparison of unpaired favorable subsets.
Native group counters exclude field/ANF, non-group inversions and SAT work; they are not a complete cost unit.
